discovery.summary: Resolve a PA legal entity and screen its legal name against OFAC
discovery.description: Resolve a supplied Pennsylvania company name to one unique strong Department of State legal-entity match, then screen the resolved legal name against current OFAC SDN primary-name and alias data. Returns candidate_found, no_candidate, company_not_found, or human_review. This is first-pass candidate-name screening only: a candidate is not a legal sanctions determination, no_candidate is not sanctions clearance, and OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania company to a unique legal entity and screen the resolved legal name against the current U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN primary-name and alias data. Returns candidate_found, no_candidate, company_not_found, or human_review. Candidate-name screening is not a legal sanctions determination; no_candidate is not sanctions clearance and OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included.

buyer.task: Resolve a prospective Pennsylvania company to a unique legal entity, then run deterministic current OFAC SDN primary-name and alias screening against the resolved legal name.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent external settled buyers and repeat demand; never count test responses, discovery visits, or synthetic transactions as sales.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: Live unique strong legal-entity resolution on paid request

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN names and aliases
sources.refresh_policy: Current SDN name/alias screening only after unique legal-entity resolution

rules: Resolve a unique strong Pennsylvania legal entity before screening the legal name, not the raw submitted name.
Use deterministic current OFAC name/alias candidates at caller-selected minScore.
A candidate is for review; no_candidate is not sanctions clearance or 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis.
candidate-name screening only; a candidate is not a legal sanctions determination
OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included
a Pennsylvania registry match does not prove good standing, ownership, or authority to contract

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.

criteria: Exact-head existing product release gates and deterministic/source checks must pass.
Authority-dependent live smokes and required production credentials (including SEC_USER_AGENT) must pass before any approved deployment.
Complete unit economics and genuine independent external-buyer evidence are unavailable; do not authorize commercial release.
